records.text: New signup alert -- *Quartz Media* just created a workspace on team.

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero product activity: no project, no invite, no milestone. Customer has never replied to either outreach (email:b6c126a2, email:c91de29b) and no-showed the welcome call (calendar:f35d4ee7). No tickets, no signal of engagement, so unaided activation in 8 days looks unlikely.

draft.subject: Getting Quartz Media started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Tunde,

Checking in after last week's welcome note. Nothing's moved yet on the Quartz Media account, so I'd like to make the first step easy.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. If it's helpful, I can walk you through creating that first project on a short call this week -- just reply with a time that suits you and I'll send an invite.

Best,
Nadia
